component.name: Paint.QT
component.summary: A raster image editor for Linux desktops, with the tool set and layout of Paint.NET

description.p: Paint.QT is a raster image editor for photos, drawings and graphics work. It is modelled on Paint.NET: the same tools, the same palette layout, the same .pdn file format, and the same history where one stroke is one undo step.

ul.li: Pencil, paintbrush, eraser, colour picker and gradient
Blur, smudge, dodge and burn, and recolour
Shapes: line, rectangle, ellipse, polygon, freeform and curve
Text, marquee and lasso selection, move, rotate, flip and scale
Layers with opacity, locking, merging and flattening
A full undo history where every stroke is a separate step
The clipboard wired to the system clipboard, so images move between applications
Reading and writing .pdn, so documents move between this editor and Paint.NET
A light theme that follows the system, and a dark one
